title: Normalized scalar unit as exact-single adjunction insertion
statement: Let C and D be Grothendieck abelian braided monoidal closed categories in the coefficient universes with the published derived tensor models and functorial flat resolutions. Let F : C → D be additive oplax monoidal with additive exact right adjoint U, and let S : D(C) → D(D) have the published derived adjunction S ⊣ D(U). Suppose e : S(1) ≅ 1 satisfies the representative UnitNormalizationAux of [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations], using any representative map whose value at the cochain unit equals the representative map built from these two adjunctions. If the ordinary adjunction transpose of the oplax unit of F is the lax unit of U, then S(singleUnitIso_C.hom) followed by e.hom and singleUnitIso_D.inv equals the adjointInsertion of that lax unit, as defined in [def-sp-exact-degree-zero-adjoint-interface].

source.place: Paragraphs 1--3, ordinary regular-unit normalization and passage to derived coefficients

proof.text: The localization monoidal unit maps and canonical single/unit comparison maps are identities in the chosen derived model. Thus UnitNormalizationAux identifies the given unit map with the representative comparison followed by localization of the ordinary oplax unit.

Apply the cochain adjunction-unit formula and exact-single adjunction formula, then naturality of the exact restriction comparison, to rewrite that representative arrow as the derived transpose of the single of the ordinary adjunction transpose. The hypothesis identifying that ordinary transpose with the lax restriction unit gives the required adjoint insertion.

proof_origin.place: P2: explicit localization-unit computation and the existing cochain/exact-single adjunction formula

theorem normalizedUnit_singleAdjunction
    {C : Type v} [Category.{u + 1} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} C]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalPreadditive C] [MonoidalClosed C] [BraidedCategory C]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} C] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution C]
    {D : Type w} [Category.{u + 1} D] [Abelian D] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} D]
    [MonoidalCategory D] [MonoidalPreadditive D] [MonoidalClosed D] [BraidedCategory D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} D] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (U : D ⥤ C) [F.Additive] [U.Additive] [F.OplaxMonoidal] [U.LaxMonoidal]
    [F.IsLeftAdjoint] [PreservesFiniteLimits U] [PreservesFiniteColimits U]
    (a : F ⊣ U) (S : _root_.DerivedCategory C ⥤ _root_.DerivedCategory D)
    (ad : S ⊣ U.mapDerivedCategory)
    (rep : ∀ P : CochainComplex C ℤ, S.obj (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⟶
      _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (e : S.obj (𝟙_ _) ≅ 𝟙_ _)
    (h : Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.UnitNormalizationAux F S rep e)
    (hrep : rep (𝟙_ _) = Etale.scalarAdjunctionRepresentativeMap F U a S ad (𝟙_ _))
    (hη : a.homEquiv _ _ (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η F) = Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε U) :
    S.map (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctorObjUnitIso C).hom ≫ e.hom ≫
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctorObjUnitIso D).inv =
    adjointInsertion U ad (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε U)
